author: ojiudezue
title: 11pm shared-space auto-off becomes a vacancy-gated failsafe that ignores leave-on; warning flash dropped
summary: Kitchen overhead stayed on 21:16-05:01 because the 23:00 sweep exempted leave-on lights. Operator: the sweep is the failsafe, so it now sweeps everything (minus manual holds) at the first vacant tick between 23:00 and a 05:00 cutoff knob, once per night, after boot settle.
why: Leave-on means 'keep on when the room empties in the evening', not 'never sweep'; the earlier review made it a blanket exemption. Vacancy gate protects people present; operator accepted that a false-occupied sensor means no sweep that night (stuck exclusion is inactive in SLEEP/HOME_NIGHT, coordinator.py:2961). Flash dropped because a sweep never fires on an occupied room, so it would warn of nothing.
implications: Applies to all 30 shared_space rooms incl. bathrooms/closets. Zone sweep and vacancy exit still honour leave-on. New knob CONF_SHARED_SPACE_AUTO_OFF_CUTOFF_HOUR (cutoff==start = old one-hour behaviour).
revisit_trigger: A room left lit overnight because a sensor read occupied all night; or complaints of lights going off on someone present.
